sql:
SELECT vendor_id, legal_name, category, criticality, onboarding_status
FROM vendor
WHERE onboarding_status IN ('requested', 'in_review')
ORDER BY vendor_id

SELECT vendor_id, legal_name, trading_name, category, requested_service, business_owner,
  annual_spend_gbp, criticality, data_categories, processing_countries, clm_supplier_ref,
  onboarding_status, requested_at
FROM vendor
WHERE vendor_id = :vendor_id

SELECT alias_id, vendor_id, alias_lower
FROM vendor_alias
WHERE vendor_id = :vendor_id
ORDER BY alias_id

description: CLM contract joined to procurement vendor
sql:
SELECT v.vendor_id, c.contract_id, c.supplier_ref, c.status, c.dpa_signed, c.dpa_signed_date,
  c.hosting_region_clause, c.transfer_mechanism, c.breach_notification_hours,
  c.subprocessor_list_attached, c.renewal_date
FROM vendor v
INNER JOIN contract c ON v.clm_supplier_ref = c.supplier_ref
WHERE v.vendor_id = :vendor_id

description: ITSM incidents matched via vendor aliases
sql:
SELECT i.incident_number, i.opened_at, i.vendor_name_raw, i.severity, i.category,
  i.root_cause_tag, i.status, i.rca_completed, i.closed_at
FROM incident i
INNER JOIN vendor_alias a
  ON lower(trim(i.vendor_name_raw)) = a.alias_lower
WHERE a.vendor_id = :vendor_id
  AND i.opened_at >= :since
ORDER BY i.opened_at DESC

description: Watchlist entries exactly matching vendor aliases
sql:
SELECT w.entry_id, w.entity_name, w.list_name, w.country, w.added_on, w.reason
FROM watchlist_entry w
INNER JOIN vendor_alias a
  ON lower(trim(w.entity_name)) = a.alias_lower
WHERE a.vendor_id = :vendor_id
ORDER BY w.entry_id

SELECT submission_id, vendor_id, submitted_at, patch_sla_critical_days, contact_role
FROM submission
WHERE vendor_id = :vendor_id
ORDER BY submitted_at DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT component_id, vendor_id, vendor_project, product, version
FROM vendor_component
WHERE vendor_id = :vendor_id
ORDER BY component_id

SELECT answer_id, submission_id, vendor_id, question_id, question, answer_text
FROM submission_answer
WHERE vendor_id = :vendor_id
ORDER BY question_id

SELECT doc_id, submission_id, vendor_id, doc_type, title, issued_on, expires_on, text
FROM submission_document
WHERE vendor_id = :vendor_id
ORDER BY doc_id

SELECT DISTINCT c.component_id, c.vendor_id, k.cve_id, k.vendor_project, k.product,
  k.vulnerability_name, k.date_added, k.due_date, k.ransomware_use
FROM vendor_component c
INNER JOIN kev_vuln k
  ON lower(k.vendor_project) = lower(c.vendor_project)
 AND lower(k.product) LIKE concat('%', lower(c.product), '%')
WHERE c.vendor_id = :vendor_id
ORDER BY k.cve_id

description: KEV lookup by product names (inline submissions)
sql:
SELECT cve_id, vendor_project, product, vulnerability_name, date_added, due_date, ransomware_use
FROM kev_vuln
WHERE lower(product) IN :products
ORDER BY cve_id

SELECT entry_id, entity_name, list_name, country, added_on, reason
FROM watchlist_entry
ORDER BY entry_id

description: ITSM incidents for normalised vendor names
sql:
SELECT incident_number, opened_at, vendor_name_raw, severity, category, root_cause_tag,
  status, rca_completed, closed_at
FROM incident
WHERE lower(trim(vendor_name_raw)) IN :names
  AND opened_at >= :since
ORDER BY opened_at DESC

description: One row for a vendor across procurement, CLM, the trust portal, and CISA KEV
sql:
SELECT v.vendor_id,
  c.status AS contract_status,
  c.dpa_signed,
  c.hosting_region_clause,
  c.breach_notification_hours,
  s.patch_sla_critical_days,
  COUNT(DISTINCT comp.component_id) AS component_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT k.cve_id) AS kev_cve_count,
  MAX(k.date_added) AS latest_kev_date
FROM vendor v
INNER JOIN contract c ON v.clm_supplier_ref = c.supplier_ref
INNER JOIN submission s ON s.vendor_id = v.vendor_id
LEFT JOIN vendor_component comp ON comp.vendor_id = v.vendor_id
LEFT JOIN kev_vuln k
  ON lower(k.vendor_project) = lower(comp.vendor_project)
 AND lower(k.product) LIKE concat('%', lower(comp.product), '%')
WHERE v.vendor_id = :vendor_id
GROUP BY v.vendor_id, c.status, c.dpa_signed, c.hosting_region_clause,
  c.breach_notification_hours, s.patch_sla_critical_days
